critical_code_review_comments: marketing.py: dead code still present — marketing_user() (L73) and require_marketing() (L90) are unused stubs returning the raw Authorization header. Nothing imports them (verified with grep). Remove so they can't be mistakenly wired in as an auth dependency.

marketing.py get_brochure(): the fallback writes directly to the final path ASSETS_DIR/'brochure.pdf'. Two concurrent cold requests will both render into the same file and can serve a truncated PDF. Render to a temp file and os.replace() atomically, and/or guard with an asyncio.Lock.

marketing.py get_brochure(): the 503 body interpolates the raw exception (`f"Brochure build failed: {e}"`) onto a public unauthenticated endpoint — leaks container filesystem paths. Log the detail and return a generic message.

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_33 503 root cause was that the endpoint shelled out to bare `python`, resolving to /usr/local/bin/python whose Playwright browser cache had no Chromium binary. The fix removed the subprocess entirely: marketing.py now does os.environ.setdefault('PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH', '/pw-browsers') at import time and renders inline with `async with async_playwright()`, so the render happens in-process with the correct browser path and without blocking the single uvicorn worker. Page-5 clipping root cause was total content height ~1222px vs the 1123px overflow:hidden .page box plus an absolutely-positioned .footer at bottom:12mm painting over the navy CTA; trimming stat-card padding 10mm→7mm, stat number 50pt→40pt, CTA padding 12mm→8mm and CTA h2 24pt→20pt brought content to 1077px, clearing both the overflow and the overlap.
